subject: general
question: Who among the former INA leaders was not charged with waging war against the British India government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohan Singh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mohan Singh was not charged with waging war against the British India government.
 
• He founded the Indian National Army (INA) in 1942. but later fell out with Subhas Chandra Bose and was relieved of his command.
 
• He was not involved in the military operations of the INA.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gurbaksh Singh Dhillon:
 
 
• He was a key figure in the INA, serving as the Commander of the Nehru Brigade.
 
• He was actively involved in military operations against the British and was subsequently charged with waging war against the British Indian government.
 
 
 
• Prem Kumar Sehgal:
 
 
• As a Colonel in the INA, Prem Kumar Sehgal played a significant role in the military campaigns against the British.
 
• He was captured and tried for waging war against the British Indian government.
 
 
 
• Shah Nawaz Khan:
 
 
• A Major General in the INA, Shah Nawaz Khan was a prominent military leader who participated in battles against the British.
 
• Like Dhillon and Sehgal, he was charged with waging war against the British Indian government.
